title: 雅思听力 · Section 1 社区游泳馆咨询（填空）

questions.explain: 原文逐字母拼读：K O W A L S K I → KOWALSKI。雅思听力人名拼写必考，要练到能逐字母记录。
questions.transcript: K O W A L S K I.

questions.explain: 原文：There is an off peak membership at twenty pounds —— £20。干扰项 £32 是普通成人月费，£15 是入会费。
questions.transcript: There is an off peak membership at twenty pounds, but it can only be used before four o'clock on weekdays.

questions.stem: Off peak membership can be used before ______ on weekdays.
questions.explain: 原文：it can only be used before four o'clock on weekdays —— 4 p.m.。注意 2 p.m. 是后文提到的"泳池最空闲时段"的起点，属信息错位干扰。
questions.transcript: It can only be used before four o'clock on weekdays.

questions.explain: 原文：there is a joining fee of fifteen pounds, which you pay only once —— 一次性 £15。
questions.transcript: One thing to remember is that there is a joining fee of fifteen pounds, which you pay only once.

questions.stem: Bring a ______ for the membership card.
questions.explain: 原文：please bring a photo for your card, and a bank letter if you want to pay monthly —— 卡上要照片；bank letter 是月付才需要，属条件干扰。
questions.transcript: Please bring a photo for your card, and a bank letter if you want to pay monthly.

questions.explain: 原文：the centre does not provide towels, so bring your own —— towels。雅思常考"不提供什么"，注意否定词。
questions.transcript: Also, the centre does not provide towels, so bring your own.

questions.stem: On Sundays the pool closes at ______.
questions.explain: 原文：The pool is open from six in the morning until ten at night, but on Sundays it closes at eight —— 转折词 but 之后是答案：8 p.m.。10 点是平日的关门时间。
questions.transcript: The pool is open from six in the morning until ten at night, but on Sundays it closes at eight.

questions.stem: Quietest time in the pool: ______ on weekdays.
questions.explain: 原文：The quietest time is between two and four in the afternoon on weekdays —— 2–4 p.m.。
questions.transcript: The quietest time is between two and four in the afternoon on weekdays.

questions.stem: Fitness classes must be booked at least ______ in advance.
questions.explain: 原文：the fitness classes must be booked at least twenty four hours in advance, and you can cancel up to two hours before without paying —— 预订要提前 24 小时；2 小时是免费取消的期限，最易混。
questions.transcript: The fitness classes must be booked at least twenty four hours in advance, and you can cancel up to two hours before without paying.

questions.stem: Members should display their card in the ______.
questions.explain: 原文：there is free parking for members, but you need to display your card in the car —— 车内展示会员卡。
questions.transcript: Yes, there is free parking for members, but you need to display your card in the car.
